title: 2021, City Council Regular Meeting Agenda PDF

votes.motion: Mark Hales moved to approve the items on the consent agenda, with Item No. 3.4 being removed
Mark Hales moved to approve Resolution No. 2021-40, Appointing Historic Preservation Commission Members Jenny Bass and Susan Bills

Jeff Gaston moved to approve Ordinance No. 2021-41, amending the Bluffdale City Land Use Ordinance, Title 11, Chapter 11.110.120, Special Purpose and Overlay Zones, to create a new zoning ordinance chapter and map designation from SG-1 Sand and Gravel to SD-C Holiday Park Project Zone for commercial uses including the associated Development and Design Standards for 18.11 acres located at approximately 15228 South Porter Rockwell Boulevard in the Independence at the Point Project

Traci Crockett moved to approve Ordinance No. 2021-13, approving a City-Initiated Text Amendment Application to amend Title 8 of the Bluffdale City Code (Water), Title 9 (Building), and Title 11 (Land Use) pertaining to water efficiency and residential landscaping requirements (Application 2021 -25)
Traci Crockett moved to approve Ordinance No. 2021-16, amending the City's adopted standards for the City's streetlight and tapping sleeve details and the City's Storm Water Design Standards Manual
